paragraphs.text: Richard William (Rich) Larson (1992) is a speculative writer born in Galmi, Niger and currently living in Ottawa, Canada.

He is the author of the novels Ymir and Annex , as well as three collections: Tomorrow Factory , The Sky Didn’t Load Today and Other Glitches , and Changelog . His fiction has appeared in over a dozen languages, including Polish, Italian, Romanian, and Japanese, and his translated collection La Fabrique des lendemains won the Grand Prix de L’Imaginaire. His short story “ Ice ” was adapted into an Emmy-winning episode of LOVE DEATH + ROBOTS .
For Wizards of the Coast , Larson wrote a Magic Story for Edge of Eternities .
